# Formwright

> Declarative, accessible forms for Ember. One `<Form>`, one `<f.Field>`: labels, ids, errors,
> `aria-invalid`, dirty state, reset and nested saves are handled. Any validator (zod, valibot,
> any Standard Schema), any data layer (WarpDrive, ember-data, ember-changeset, plain objects),
> and harnesses for testing forms the way users use them. Ember 6.12 LTS and 7.x.

```gts
import { Form } from '@ember-formwright/ember'

<template>
  <Form @model={{@user}} @validator={{userSchema}} @onSubmit={{@save}} as |f|>
    <f.Field @for="email" @control="email" @label="Email" />
    <f.Submit />
  </Form>
</template>
```

## Packages

- `@ember-formwright/ember`: the `Form`, `Field` and `Button` components, the built-in controls,
  and the registries for controls, layouts and model adapters
- `@ember-formwright/test-support`: form harnesses and normalized `data-test` selectors
- `@ember-formwright/layouts`: horizontal, compact and checkbox-after field layouts, and an
  Actions bar
- `@ember-formwright/warp-drive`: a model adapter for WarpDrive / ember-data records
- `@ember-formwright/changeset`: a model adapter and validator for ember-changeset
- `@ember-formwright/real-enums`: real-enums classes as select, radio and checkbox options
- `@ember-formwright/power-select`: searchable, async and multiple selects
- `@ember-formwright/power-calendar`: date and date-range pickers
- `@ember-formwright/maskito`: masked inputs and a phone number input
- `@ember-formwright/file-upload`: file inputs and drop zones
- `@ember-formwright/tiptap`: a rich-text control

- [Site](https://joegaudet.com/ember-formwright/): overview and live demo
- [Guide](https://joegaudet.com/ember-formwright/guide/): every argument, control and hook, each
  with a live example

- [Migrating from ember-foxy-forms](https://github.com/joegaudet/ember-formwright/blob/main/MIGRATION.md)
